qa_pairs.question: What specific environment variable must be manually configured to prevent Fluent from crashing on the Nibi cluster when using the default Intel MPI?
qa_pairs.answer: When using the Nibi cluster, `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` must be manually set when the default Intel MPI is used, otherwise Fluent will crash on startup.

qa_pairs.question: What error message might appear if Fluent crashes on the Nibi cluster because the `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` environment variable was not set?
qa_pairs.answer: Error output such as `[mpiexec@g4.nibi.sharcnet] Error: Unable to run bstrap_proxy on g4.nibi.sharcnet (pid 2251587, exit code 256)` and `[mpiexec@g4.nibi.sharcnet] Error setting up the bootstrap proxies` will be produced.

qa_pairs.question: How should a user resolve a Fluent crash on the Nibi cluster caused by the `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` environment variable not being set?
qa_pairs.answer: To recover from this, close Fluent, shut down Workbench, and try again after ensuring `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` is manually set.
